name: Roblox Luau Quest & Objective Tracker
description: Typed Roblox Luau ModuleScript service for tracking per-player quest states, incrementing objective counters, and emitting completion rewards cleanly on the server.

preview.caption: Roblox Luau server module — store QuestConfig in ReplicatedStorage/Quests/QuestConfig and QuestService in ServerScriptService/Quests/QuestService.
architecture: QuestService.AcceptQuest(userId, questId) & RecordProgress(userId, objectiveType, delta, onCompleted)
preview.projectRef: Place QuestConfig.luau as a ModuleScript at ReplicatedStorage/Quests/QuestConfig and QuestService.luau as a ModuleScript at ServerScriptService/Quests/QuestService.

install: Create a Folder named Quests in ReplicatedStorage with ModuleScript QuestConfig (QuestConfig.luau), and a Folder named Quests in ServerScriptService with ModuleScript QuestService (QuestService.luau).
usage: Require ServerScriptService.Quests.QuestService on the server, call QuestService.AcceptQuest(player.UserId, "slime_hunt"), and report progress via QuestService.RecordProgress(player.UserId, "defeat_slime", 1, onCompleted).

verification.label: Source & Structure Checked (Roblox Luau)
verification.details: Strict Luau source (--!strict) checked by scripts/validate-components.mjs for ReplicatedStorage/Quests/QuestConfig path consistency, type exports, and block structure. Not executed in Roblox Studio in CI.
